item.title: The Pentagon Hopes to Speed Up ‘Kill Chain’ AI Buys With 5-Minute Videos
item.description: The US government’s Tradewinds initiative has made it easier to throw millions of dollars at “nontraditional” defense contractors, including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

item.title: OpenAI Wants Its New Agent to Run Your Life. Mine Said It Loved Me
item.description: Dots are designed to automate online tasks, like buying furniture. In my initial experience, the always-on agent was a bit buggy and couldn’t complete a captcha.

item.title: Your Next Great Read Might Be Certified ‘Organic’
item.description: Amid a sea of AI writing slop, a new stamp for “organic literature” will help readers to pick out books authored by real, corn-fed, free-range humans.

item.title: ‘Artificial’ Roasts AI’s Creators—and Sends a Dark Warning About Its Dangers
item.description: From their dorky parties to their weird walks, the movie holds OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and other stakeholders with contempt, while demonstrating their recklessness.

item.title: OpenAI Is Pissing Off a Bunch of Mathematicians—Again
item.description: “There’s a perception of mobster behavior” from leading AI companies, one mathematician tells WIRED as OpenAI prepares to release more than 100 new solutions to unsolved problems.

item.title: Mistral Says Its New AI Model ‘Le Chonk’ Is the Best Open-Weight Offering Outside of China
item.description: With the release of its new trillion-parameter model, Mistral is hoping to demonstrate it’s “still in the race” to build frontier-level artificial intelligence.

item.title: Kevin Roose Didn’t Use AI to Write His Book About AI
item.description: The author of The AGI Chronicles says his book “was written by a very tired, overworked, under-slept human being.”

item.title: Rural Data Centers Are in for a Big Federal Tax Break
item.description: Under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, data center projects in rural areas could be eligible for major tax benefits starting next year. Some hyperscalers do not seem eager to take the free cash.

item.title: The Nvidia Shield TV Is 7 Years Old. It Just Got a $100 Price Hike
item.description: The price of anything with memory is skyrocketing thanks to AI. Aging streaming devices are no exception.

item.title: Muse Creates Detailed Profiles of All Your Friends and Family
item.description: Millions have downloaded Meta’s AI agent Muse. But getting it to do your bidding comes with privacy costs.
